scope: Volume III visual refinements and CNN correspondence fixes

source_review.visual_evidence: All active assets inspected at source resolution:144 non-history vector/data assets by figure_audit,3 history diagrams by root,complex assets split between root and transformer_audit. Subsequent changed assets reviewed again.
mechanism_checks: CNN main chain does not connect to operator-detail panels; layer names specify correspondence. Operator arrows checked separately.
Transformer attention variants share12.8 panel layout; Q/K/V,mask,normalization,residual topology checked.
S4 input direct pathD,state recurrence; RWKV separate time mixing; local attention row outputs and6x6 band support checked.
SNN exact step and surrogate curves regenerated from analytical expressions.
limitations: Visual checks are bounded to figure appearance and the revised scientific relations.
Final PDF page inspection follows build and is preserved in ignored build/volume-three-refinement; this source report does not claim PDF inspection.
cnn_final_adjustments: VGG Conv4/Conv5 labels fit their headings
GoogLeNet pooling text below input arrow; redundant title removed
source_review.replay: 80 decoded RGB pixel matches; changed CNN overlays replayed after final revision
